title: Onboard aurora-lite-3b v1.2: perf metadata, profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Rao
description: Motivation: Add aurora-lite-3b v1.2 to the model registry with curated performance metadata and automated changelog generation. This PR introduces model metadata (labels, tokenizer/version, compatible runtime/quantization knobs), standardized performance profiles (latency/throughput targets for common sequence lengths and batch sizes), and a changelog automation hook that emits a release entry when model metadata or profiles change. Changes include data model updates, new perf YAMLs, benchmarking harness integration for verification, docs additions, and a small CI job to validate changelog formatting. The description below summarizes intent, approach, tests, and rollout plan: Intent: ensure aurora-lite-3b v1.2 is fully onboarded with perf profiles that map to our Dedicated and Hosted runtime knobs so teams can safely pin this model and rely on the documented SLOs. Approach: 1) Add metadata JSON for aurora-lite-3b v1.2 including model card references and tokenizer hashes. 2) Add perf profiles under perf-profiles/aurora-lite-3b/v1.2/ covering seq lengths 64/256/1024 and batch sizes 1/8/32 with observed p50/p95 token latencies and throughput numbers. 3) Integrate benchmark harness so perf numbers are validated by the CI perf-suite job (synthetic load + sample traces). 4) Add changelog automation: a GitHub Action that looks for changes under model metadata or perf-profiles and produces a changelog fragment in content/changelogs/models/ with standardized sections (what changed, perf impact, recommended rollout). 5) Update model-registry README with onboarding checklist and how to run local perf checks. Tests: unit tests for metadata schema validation, a perf validation script with mocked env that runs in CI, and lint/docs checks. Rollout: gated by CI perf-suite stability; initial merge will register model in staging-only catalog and trigger a short internal announcement. Risks/mitigations: perf-suite was flaky initially due to sampling variance; added deterministic seed and warmup steps to reduce noise. No API or schema breaking changes. Requesting review from runtime and perf owners for profile validation and from docs for changelog wording.
